id: title:Gilbert09:add four aws cost explorer tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for AWS Cost Explorer, including account and service dimensions, reservation and savings plans coverage, and pagination resumption, while removing the AWS Cost Explorer source from the warehouse coverage appendix.
review.reason: This chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it adds configuration and documentation for AWS Cost Explorer ingestion, including account and service dimensions, reservation and savings plans coverage, and pagination resumption, while removing the AWS Cost Explorer source from the warehouse coverage appendix. This could help warehouse users who need this AWS
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the new AWS Cost Explorer API calls, only the configuration and documentation. No tier assignment is possible.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader implementation and validation, not just this hunk.

observations.behavior: Removes AWS Cost Explorer source from the warehouse coverage appendix and its settings entry.
observations.code_quote: - [x] `Dimension values (GetDimensionValues, POST /)` — resolves linked account IDs in cost tables to account names and provides dimension metadata (high)
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces warehouse ingestion coverage; AWS account dimension and account name resolution no longer available in warehouse reports.

observations.behavior: Adds slice_key to AwsCostExplorerResumeConfig and its frozen=True, and adds slice_key parameter to build_payload, including Dimension and Context, and optionally Filter by SERVICE.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports AWS Cost Explorer dimension-based queries, including account and service dimensions, while preserving page state for resumption.

observations.behavior: Adds max_lookback_days and current_day handling to resolve start date, and adds slice_key and window_services parameters to build_payload, including Dimension, Context, and Filter by SERVICE.
observations.posthog_connection: Respects configured lookback and current-day inclusion, and supports service-filtered queries, while retaining account and service dimensions.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new AWS Cost Explorer API calls, only the configuration and documentation. No tier assignment is possible.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation and configuration for four new AWS Cost Explorer API endpoints: dimension_values, cost_and_usage_with_resources_daily, reservation_coverage_daily, savings_plans_coverage_daily.
observations.code_quote: "description": "Daily share of reservation eligible usage that reservations covered, per service (EC2, RDS, ElastiCache and Redshift).",
observations.posthog_connection: Adds metadata and column definitions for warehouse ingestion of AWS reservation and savings plans coverage, which could support warehouse users who need this data.

observations.behavior: Allows granularity to be None, and adds configuration for dimension, service, and lookback parameters.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion to support APIs that do not support granularity, such as GetDimensionValues.

observations.behavior: Adds a test for the 14-day lookback limit of GetCostAndUsageWithResources.
observations.code_quote: assert resolve_start_date("2024-01-01", WITH_RESOURCES, False, None, self.END) == dt.date(2024, 5, 17)
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that warehouse ingestion respects AWS API limits, preventing ingestion of unavailable historical data.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test additions. No implementation, configuration, or shared dependency changes are supplied, so no score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds five new unit tests for AWS Cost Explorer ingestion, including: 1) filtering resource costs to services listed for the window; 2) skipping resource requests when no services are requested; 3) listing dimension values per dimension with attributes; 4) resuming at a saved dimension and page; 5) walking savings plans coverage next-token pages; 6) requesting and tagging per-resume
observations.posthog_connection: These tests could help prevent regressions in AWS Cost Explorer ingestion, but without the corresponding implementation or shared dependency changes, no tier can be assigned.
